fixed: The long zoom out from the molecule took nearly the whole line, so the Earth was barely seen; flights now take at most 2.3 s, and the Earth fills the frame.
The comet was a small speck; it is a glowing head with a fan of tail streaming away from the Sun now.
The frost on the computer's screen was white sticks; it is an icy haze creeping in from the corners with six-armed crystals.
The cloud before the Sun was flat circles; it is soft glowing billows now.

The dive from the whole cloud down to one speck of dust was nearly empty dark for 3 s; specks of dust and ice stream past now, and stars streak past whenever the camera flies through space. The self-check measured no empty stretch.
notes: One journey: out of the molecule, past the kitchen and the coast to the Earth, to a comet, to the Sun, the picture shrinking into a computer's screen, frost, time running back to the dark cloud, and down to one speck of dust icing over.
